fix.summary: All three Review-035 findings are sustained at current HEAD `be9302d85804c3289b360e87c94b85fecc25f607`. HEAD differs from the reviewed production target only by the published Review-035 docket, so the cited production shapes remain current. The extracted construction and bundle-materializer modules are useful but do not complete the expressly retained admission/compiler/lifecycle and workspace/executor ownership splits. Separately, `src/reviewer-role.ts:197-200` directly violates the amended driver-facing result boundary by returning the accepted dispatch and prompt-bearing outcomes. Apply the three direct Fixer classes below; no Plan or owner choice is needed. Typecheck and 36 focused Reviewer tests pass on this HEAD, but `test/reviewer-role.test.ts:88-94` currently codifies the prohibited rich Agent result and those passing tests do not discharge the retained cohesion obligations.

classes.name: Reviewer construction ownership
classes.owner: `reviewer-dispatch` owns only the irreversible proposal lifecycle and acceptance chronology; a mechanical admission seam owns proposal/grant/hint validation; the pinned-Git seam owns range/material acquisition and normalization; `reviewer-construction` owns bundle, prompt, identity, and accepted-dispatch compilation from admitted immutable inputs and pinned evidence.
classes.boundary: Replace the current `preflightAndCompileDispatch` multi-owner body with calls across those typed seams. Admission must be decidable without repository I/O or prompt construction. Pinned evidence collection may resolve/read only after admission and must preserve correctable-versus-infrastructure failure truth. Construction receives admitted data plus frozen target/range/material evidence and deterministically returns the bundle, axis prompts, identities, and accepted dispatch. The lifecycle coordinator retains concurrent correction/closure, final target-drift check, acceptance evidence, and exactly-once runner invocation; it must not parse proposal fields, read material bytes, or render prompt/bundle content itself. Prove the seams through unit interfaces and lifecycle tests, not source-size or source-text assertions.
classes.disposition: Sustain Standards finding 1 as an incomplete authorized class, not a line-count complaint. `reviewer-construction.ts` is already a real delegated compiler, but `src/reviewer-dispatch.ts:318-375` still performs admission, capability policy, Git reads, evidence normalization, task decoding, prompt rendering/recompilation, and accepted-dispatch assembly inside the lifecycle owner. Preserve all current admission, target, identity, correction, and race behavior while completing the retained owner split.

classes.name: Reviewer workspace ownership
classes.owner: A Git workspace owner owns command execution, pinned mirror creation/verification, per-leg clone creation, bundle installation, disposal, and truthful retention evidence; a child executor owns provider/runtime/session creation, accepted tool/bash authorization, prompt delivery, usage collection, and provider/child failure classification; `reviewer-agent` owns only accepted-batch orchestration and settlement.
classes.boundary: Give the coordinator prepared workspace leases plus materialization evidence from the workspace owner, and terminal child results from the executor. Preserve the invariant that every required clone is verified and its bundle installed before either provider starts, then run accepted legs concurrently and settle all siblings. Workspace deletion or retained-path evidence remains with the workspace lease owner; provider/session cleanup remains with the child executor; the coordinator maps those typed results into the existing complete dispatch outcome and retains irreversible acceptance and shutdown semantics. Add seam tests showing workspace preparation can be exercised without a provider, child execution can be exercised against an already-prepared workspace without Git materialization, and orchestration still preserves prepare-before-provider, settlement, cleanup, cancellation, and failure honesty.
classes.disposition: Sustain Standards finding 2 as the other expressly retained incomplete class. `reviewer-bundle-materializer.ts` is a valid narrow boundary, but `src/reviewer-agent.ts` still owns the surrounding Git mirror/workspace lifecycle and the provider/session executor in the same changing module. This is not a demand to split a merely large coordinator: the concrete workspace-resource lifecycle and child-model execution have distinct invariants and failure/cleanup ownership.

classes.name: Thin Agent result
classes.owner: The `Agent` tool presentation adapter in `src/reviewer-role.ts` owns the result visible to the driver; the execution ledger and `reviewer-settlement.ts` continue to own rich internal evidence and runtime receipt assembly.
classes.boundary: For a successfully settled accepted call, return only the existing accepted settlement status and batch identity in tool details (equivalent to `{ status: "accepted", identity }`) and a text rendering containing no additional construction or per-axis evidence. Do not expose `AcceptedReviewerDispatch`, grants, prompts, bundle entries/bytes, target evidence, or outcome objects through the Agent tool result. Do not narrow the internal dispatcher result before `executeAndProjectDispatch` has projected exact terminal results into the ledger. Keep accepted-leg and prompt validation, report byte preservation, semantic audit, completed/refused receipt assembly, post-settlement active-tool lockout, and fatal/failed-settlement honesty unchanged. Replace the current rich-result test with an exact public-shape regression and retain receipt tests proving the hidden evidence still reaches the runtime-owned V2 receipt.
classes.disposition: Sustain Spec finding 3. `src/reviewer-role.ts:197-200` currently returns `dispatch: result.dispatch` and prompt-bearing per-axis outcomes, and `test/reviewer-role.test.ts:90-91` explicitly expects that leak. Narrow only this driver-facing projection; the rich accepted dispatch and outcomes remain lawful and required inside the ledger, auditor input, and final receipt.

details.note: Review disposition is complete: none of the three findings is dismissed or deferred. No new public authority, parallel lifecycle, report parser, replacement leg, compatibility core, or Soul change is authorized.
